name: NMS

boxes.description: Bounding boxes tensor of shape (N, 4). Supports float32, float16.

scores.description: Scores tensor of shape (N,). Same dtype as boxes.

max_output_size.description: int, maximum number of output boxes.

scores_threshold.description: float, score threshold to filter boxes.

pad_to_max_output_size.description: Optional bool, pad output to max_output_size. Default false.

num_selected.description: Number of selected boxes, int32 scalar tensor.

description:
NMS: NPU-accelerated Non-Maximum Suppression on bounding boxes.

torch_npu.npu_nms_v4 — performs NMS on NPU, filtering overlapping boxes by IoU.

Args:
    boxes (Tensor): Bounding boxes tensor of shape (N, 4) in (x1, y1, x2, y2) format.
    scores (Tensor): Scores tensor of shape (N,).
    max_output_size (int): Maximum number of output boxes.
    iou_threshold (float): IoU threshold for suppression.
    scores_threshold (float): Score threshold to filter low-confidence boxes.
    pad_to_max_output_size (bool, optional): Whether to pad output to max_output_size. Default: False.

Returns: tuple of (selected_indices, num_selected).

---
Pure PyTorch equivalent:
    1. Filter boxes by scores > scores_threshold
    2. Sort remaining boxes by score descending
    3. Iteratively select highest-scoring box, suppress boxes with IoU >= iou_threshold
    4. Return selected indices and count
